WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.G.S. KAMAL
ORAL ORDER

Petitioner is before this Court being aggrieved by the General Award dated 03.11.2023 passed respondent No.3- SLAO and directing the respondent-Authorities to pass the consent award in terms of Section 29(2) of the Karnataka Industrial Area Development Act, 1966.

2. Admittedly, suit in O.S.No.244/2021 is pending consideration on the file of Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Malur between the petitioner and the other family members for the relief of partition in which, amongst others, the petition schedule property is also included.
In that view of the matter, no fault can be found with the respondent-Authorities in passing of the general award.

4. It is made clear that in the event said suit being disposed of, in the manner known to law or in the event of contesting parties therein arrive at any settlement to obtain the compensation payable by the respondent-authorities, it is open for the petitioner to make a fresh representation in that event,
the same may be considered by the respondent- KIADB in accordance with law.
